**Do NOT report security vulnerabilities here.**

If you have discovered a security vulnerability, please refer to our [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) policy for instructions on how to securely disclose it to the maintainers.

Do not post PoC code or details of the vulnerability in the public issue tracker.
